items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Yeah, Louis Handy is the Grand Marshal for the Eagles.

ctx.x: Yeah, Louis Handy is the Grand Marshal for the Eagles.

The Eagles, did they ever have a clubhouse on Eagle Street? There was one years ago I remember in an old directory. I wondered if the organization got their name from the Eagle Street No. All over the country. All over the country there's an Eagles organization too I know. That Eagle. Sorry, don't worry about that. We all got a call.

They are. No, they're smoking. This Eagles set up in the later years. See this Eagles set up in the later years. I remember when they set it up because I played for dedication at Bantam. Were they on Eagle Street at that time? No. They're right where they are now. They meet in that hall at Adam and Dominican. That's where they meet at. They always did meet there. And the President belongs to the young men of Olympia also. Most of the men, a lot of the men belongs to the Eagle and the Olympia and the young and…
